rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, that's a generous offer and very welcome. The most useful thing right now is a scoped first task. We're thinking about building a small open dataset on how ready frontier AI developers are for incident reporting: how their published safety frameworks handle detecting, escalating, and disclosing safety incidents. Before committing, we want to make sure we're not duplicating someone else's work. First task (about 3–5 hours): a prior-art scan. Find existing datasets and trackers that cover frontier AI developers' safety commitments or incident reporting (the AI Incident Database, think-tank commitment trackers, academic papers, etc.). For each one, note the scope, which companies it covers, its main fields, how often it's updated, and its licence. A simple spreadsheet is perfect. If it turns out there's a real gap, I'd love your help designing the coding rubric and data schema next. No pressure on timing. Anything in the next couple of weeks would be great. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: I replied from your account with a first task of 3–5 hours: check whether existing trackers already cover this data before we commit to the project.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold weekly review" (0 9 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: I set up a review every Monday at 9am.
